summary: Observability and security platform for monitoring metrics, logs, traces and incidents.
access_note: API key plus application key from org settings; account needed (trial/paid plan assumed, not verified).
blocker_note: Datadog is a paid product; no free tier or trial terms were confirmed in fetched docs.

evidence.quote: Authenticate to the API with an API key using the header `DD-API-KEY`.
For most users, OAuth 2.0 is the recommended authentication method, and your MCP client handles it during setup.
If you have the permission to create application keys, click New Key.
The Datadog API is an HTTP REST API.
The Datadog MCP Server acts as a bridge between your observability data in Datadog and any AI agents

notes: Access and trial status not confirmed from any pricing page; verdict leans on general knowledge that Datadog needs a paid plan or trial. MCP URL is region-specific (US1 shown); US1-FED/US2-FED unsupported. The MCP page says it is under significant development.
